Materials, gold content, and gemstones have not been lab or chemically tested beyond visible stamped hallmarks (such as Sterling and 14K); pieces are described based on visual appearance. Waterman Paris
Striped Lacquer Fountain Pen - Gold Trim
Late 20th Century, France
This Waterman Paris fountain pen exemplifies the elegant French design and reliable engineering that defined the brand's production after moving operations to France in the mid-20th century. Featuring a slim, sophisticated profile, the barrel and cap are finished in a dark lacquer with subtle vertical burgundy stripes, complemented by gold-tone accents and rings. The Waterman brand, established in 1884, is renowned for inventing the first functional fountain pen feed, a legacy of quality visible in this late vintage example.
Marked "WATERMAN MADE IN FRANCE" on the central gold-tone band
Gold-tone nib featuring the Waterman "W" logo and ornate scrollwork
Includes original blue Waterman Paris presentation box with white satin lining
Original user manual booklet and one blue ink cartridge included
Condition:
Excellent vintage condition. The pen body shows only very light surface micro-scratches consistent with careful storage and minimal use. The gold trim is bright and free of pitting or significant tarnish. The nib appears clean and well-maintained. The presentation box and paperwork are in very good condition with minor shelf wear to the outer casing.

shipping.policy:
SHIPPING:
"ALL ITEMS/COMBINED ITEMS OVER $100.00 WILL REQUIRE A SIGNATURE"
Items are shipped within 5 working days depending on the season. Shipping business days are Monday through Friday 7am - 3pm. We are closed on weekends and holidays.
We cannot guarantee that we will get and be able to apply alternative address if different than what is on customer's account. We will do our best to make sure items are shipped out to address requested.
IF YOU HAVE US FILE A CLAIM WITH FED EX FOR NON-DELIVERY REFUND WILL HAVE TO WAIT UNTIL FED EX RESPONDS TO THE CLAIM, UNTIL THAT TIME MONEY WILL NOT BE REFUNDED. IF FED EX STATES THAT THEY DELIVERED THE ITEM CORRECTLY AND YOU DID NOT RECEIVE THE ITEM IT MAY HAVE BEEN STOLEN FROM YOUR PROPERTY AND WE ARE NOT RESPONSIBLE FOR THEFT OF ITEMS.
ITEMS ARE NOT SHIPPED BY COST OF ACTUAL WEIGHT. ITEMS ARE SHIPPED AND CHARGED BY SIZE OF THE BOX THESE ITEM/ITEMS ARE SHIPPED IN. THIS IS CALLED DIM WEIGHT BY FED EX (AND UPS). THIS IS HOW WE ARE CHARGED FOR SHIPPING AND THIS IS HOW WE CHARGE OUR CUSTOMERS FOR SHIPPING. THIS PROCESS OF SHIPPING HAS BEEN THIS WAY FOR MORE THAN 2 YEARS.
COMBINED SHIPPING:
Items that are already paid for cannot be combined with another item and shipping weight will not be adjusted.
Items that can safely be combined in the same box may be done at the time of payment. These items are not blocked from combining. Items that are blocked need prior contact from us to assure that the items will arrive safely to your home. Please be aware Shop Goodwill will only allow up to 20lbs. to be combined at one time.
Combined Shipping will accumulate $3.00 for each item up to $6.00 for 2 items. If you purchase more than 2 items then there is no additional charge for handling. Handling fee is non-refundable.
PLEASE BE AWARE YOU CANNOT COMBINE BUY IT NOW ITEMS WITH OTHER ORDERS - THESE ARE RULES SET IN PLACE BY ORANGE COUNTY GOODWILL WHO RUNS THE SITE.

description:
Natural Specimen
Quartz Geode Crystal Cluster
Mineral on Green Host Rock Matrix
Approximately 3.5" x 2.5" x 2"
Unsigned
This striking natural geode specimen features a cavity of sparkling clear quartz crystals nestled within a vibrant, teal-green host rock matrix. The exterior coloration suggests the presence of copper-bearing minerals such as chrysocolla or malachite, providing a dramatic visual contrast to the prismatic crystalline interior. This piece serves as a sophisticated organic accent, showcasing the raw geological beauty and complex textures found in natural mineral formations.
Features a well-defined interior cavity lined with translucent quartz crystal clusters
Natural green and turquoise-toned host rock with earthy iron-oxide inclusions on the reverse
Unique asymmetrical form suitable for shelf, desk, or cabinet display
Condition:
Excellent natural condition. As a raw geological specimen, it retains its original jagged edges and characteristic surface variations. The crystal points appear well-preserved within the cavity, and the surrounding matrix is stable with minor natural surface wear typical of extracted mineral specimens.

description:
Hemingray Glass Company
No. 12 Insulator
Pressed Glass, Aqua Blue, Antique/Vintage
Authentic Hemingray No. 12 glass insulator, a classic piece of American industrial history. Produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, this model was widely used for telephone and telegraph lines during the late 19th and early 20th centuries. It features the signature aqua blue glass and technical design elements common to the era's utility infrastructure.
Embossed "HEMINGRAY NO. 12" on the front skirt
Embossed "PATENT MAY 2 1893" on the reverse side
Sharp drip points along the bottom base edge designed to shed moisture
Translucent aqua blue glass with characteristic manufacturing seed bubbles and swirls
Approximately 3.75 inches tall by 3 inches wide
Condition:
Significant chip and glass loss on the bottom skirt edge as shown in photographs. Minor surface soot and mineral deposits within the interior threads and grooves. Main dome and upper wire grooves remain structurally sound. Original glass color is vibrant with no internal stress cracks.

Discover a unique assortment with this mixed gemstone lot, perfect for collectors, jewelry makers, or enthusiasts exploring natural minerals. This selection includes five distinct pieces: a finely polished agate slice showcasing intricate banding and rich, earthy hues; a rectangular amber piece featuring an organic inclusion; a clear quartz crystal point with natural terminations; a rough reddish-brown tourmaline cluster exhibiting raw crystal structure; and a deep garnet cluster with naturally formed surfaces. Each stone brings its own visual appeal and tactile qualities, whether you're interested in display, crafting, or study. The agate slice is ideal for decorative settings, the amber is prized by fossil and crystal lovers, while tourmaline, quartz, and garnet are versatile for lapidary or educational use. Condition ranges from polished to raw, highlighting the beauty of each gem's origin. Purchase confidently knowing each stone is naturally sourced and untreated, making this lot a diverse addition for any gemstone aficionado.

Shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). Orders will be shipped within
5 business days
(Monday-Friday) of payment. However, we make every effort to ship sooner. Shipping may be delayed in the event of unforeseen business closure for holidays, disasters, etc.
Our shipping software shops for the best shipping option for your order. The carrier that the item is listed with may not be the carrier with which the item(s) ship.
Combined Shipping:
Items may be combined to save on shipping charges if the auctions close within 7 days of each other, are safe to ship in one box, and we are contacted prior to payment. Once paid for, items are no longer eligible to be combined. Once a combined shipping charge has been calculated for an order, no additional items may be added to an order.
Because of how our carriers charge for shipping, item weight is calculated based on the dimensional weight and not the actual weight of the item. This can potentially add to the shipping charge of combined orders if larger shipping materials are required.
Most of our Jewelry items are listed with a flat rate shipping fee. If you purchase more than one item, please send a Customer Service ticket through your Shopgoodwill.com account before paying so that we can remove the flat rate fee. After the flat rate fees are removed shipping cost will be calculated directly from the courier's site. Art, glass, musical instruments, prepackaged lots, heavy items, and other fragile items may not be eligible for combined shipping.
We do not ship orders to PO Boxes.
You will need a physical street address to receive your packages.
Signature Verification
: For all orders $1000 or more, packages must be signed for by an adult in the household.
Attention:
Goodwill Middle TN is not responsible for lost or stolen packages after delivery to the customer has been confirmed with tracking information. Contact FedEx or USPS for further information.

.

delivered

Purchased items will be shipped as specified within the order. We are unable to reroute packages once processed. Please ensure any address changes are made prior to payment during the checkout process. Per FedEx policies, we cannot accept P.O. boxes, please provide us with a physical address.

Combined shipping

The items are from the same Goodwill location.
The items close within the same week.
You have not already paid for any of the items.
The combined weight does not exceed 20 pounds.
Items are not already in a fixed-price, flat-rate shipping box.
Items can't be purchased via buy-it-now or with 1 cent shipping.
You will be automatically prompted to combine all available items during checkout. If the site does not, please submit a customer service ticket for inquiry; some exceptions may be made.
